name: Scan Health
summary: Scan Health — what your scans can and can't see. Per asset: credential health from the Target Credential Status / Issues plugins (104410 failed, 110385/102094 insufficient privilege, 117885 intermittent, 110723 none provided, 141118/110095 OK) and plugin 19506, patch-assessment failures (21745), scan freshness, agent vs network, crown-jewel blind spots. Per scanner / policy / scan: time per asset, load share, credential success, Nessus version and plugin-feed currency, safe-checks off. Tags the exact assets under Scan Health (gated). Can run for the whole estate or for one tag's assets (switch between them; tag writes stay inside the tag).

widgets.title: Credentialed vs blind assets
widgets.note: Scanned assets the scanner logged in to, against those it could not see inside.
widgets.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ok=1 THEN 'Credentialed' ELSE 'Blind (no credentials)' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS assets FROM (SELECT v.asset_uuid, MAX(CASE WHEN $__cred(v) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok FROM vulns v WHERE v.plugin_id IN ('19506','141118','110095','104410','110385','102094','117885','110723') AND $__scope(v.asset_uuid) GROUP BY v.asset_uuid) GROUP BY status

lineage.t: Assets with a scan-information or credential-status plugin = scanned
